verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official, first-party MCP server that gives AI agents tools to interact with the Stripe API and search Stripe's knowledge base, and a probe confirms it at docs.stripe.com/mcp. Stripe Issuing is part of the Stripe API, so an agent can connect through this server. missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server exposes Issuing-specific tools (card/cardholder creation, spending controls, authorizations), detailed setup/auth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
